verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is Algolia's official `algolia-migration` agent skill for migrating API client code to the latest major version, which implies the client libraries are major-versioned with managed breaking changes. Nothing in the pack shows the REST API itself is versioned or that any deprecation policy exists. missing for 10: documented REST API versioning scheme, documented deprecation policy and timelines, sunset/changelog notices, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy

citations.quote: Migrate API client code to the latest major version (JS, Python, Go, PHP, Java, C#, Ruby, Kotlin, Scala, Swift)
